landing.eyebrow: A clear plan for a meaningful trip
landing.title: Journey helps you gather inspiration, keep your prep on track, and begin each trip with a lighter mind.
landing.description: The first phase focuses on a strong foundation: real sign-in, a protected personal area, a clear dashboard, a synced profile, and a steady path toward the trips experience later on.
landing.phaseTitle: Build the foundation properly from the start
landing.phaseDescription: Public and private routes, session restore, a clear session strategy, and core screens that are ready for the next development cycle.
landing.nextDependencyValue: Trips workspace and detailed itinerary planning

plan.title: Plan with structure
plan.description: From sign-in to dashboard to the trips frame, the whole flow is aligned up front so the product does not need heavy rework halfway through.

experience.title: Keep the experience inspiring
experience.description: The visual direction follows a warm travel journal with room to breathe and a clear point of view instead of a generic dashboard.

community.title: Expand into community at the right time
community.description: Community now has a real feed and detail flow so public trips can start turning into stories people actually browse.

hero.description: This homepage opens with the scrapbook mood first: photos, paper layers, a map, and route previews so Journey reads as a place to gather inspiration, prepare a trip, and tell the story afterward.
hero.readyValue: Warm, travel-heavy, playful with paper details, and still structured enough to grow into a real product surface.
hero.surfaceValue: Only the homepage is implemented in this pass. Community, planner, journal, and profile are still previews inside the landing page.

floatingNote.title: The homepage should spark the story before it sends people into concrete tasks.
floatingNote.description: The visual language leans on aged paper, tape, photos, and map pins to feel narrative-driven. The later routes can build on top of the same brand direction without changing tone.

map.title: From north to south, each stop should feel like a small story worth opening next.
map.description: The parchment map anchors the landing page visually and bridges the inspirational side of travel with later practical surfaces like the planner and journal editor.
map.moodValue: Ink traces, color pins, aged paper, and stops with distinct personalities.
map.nextValue: This landing can later connect into community, planner, journal, and profile without losing its visual voice.

sapa.title: Sapa at dawn
sapa.description: cool air, terraced fields, and a slower breath

hanoi.title: Old Hanoi corner
hanoi.description: a classic morning, coffee, and distant traffic

hue.title: Hue at dusk
hue.description: old walls, thin sunlight, and soft yellow tones

nhaTrang.title: Nha Trang shore
nhaTrang.description: salt air, stronger wind, and a longer horizon

saiGon.title: Late Saigon
saiGon.description: street lights, fast motion, and stories everywhere

previews.title: The homepage does not tell everything, but it should preview the rhythm of every surface that comes next.
previews.description: The four cards below act as previews for the routes we will build next. Each surface keeps the scrapbook brand while leaning into a more specific purpose.

community.title: Read real travel stories before you set off.
community.description: Community will collect public stories, short feed moments, cover images, and deeper writing without diluting the planner experience.

planner.title: Turn inspiration into a trip frame that feels reliable.
planner.description: Planner stays structured and data-first, separated from the freeform journal so people can return to it and edit it throughout the trip lifecycle.

journal.title: Bring photos, notes, and stickers back into the feel of a travel notebook.
journal.description: Journal will be the only freeform surface. This homepage borrows just enough of that spirit to establish the brand and lead naturally into the editor later.

profile.title: Keep identity and preparation inside the same familiar space.
profile.description: Profile will gather account details, activity history, and tracked trips while staying grounded in the same visual material as the rest of Journey.

footer.tagline: Keep travel inspiration in a form that feels handwritten, warm, and easy to return to, then extend that same energy into the tools that help a trip get prepared and retold with more care.
footer.profileNote: Profile is the next surface planned within the same scrapbook language.
